fusions.name: Tangled Duckweed
fusions.desc: Throws weed up around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Caged] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Pondrot Peck
fusions.desc: Pecks for 30 damage, makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Floating Garden
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of duckweed 4 tiles across for 10 seconds. You and any ally inside regain 3 health a second.

fusions.name: Rooted Float
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
